description: Implement a comprehensive image preloading system that extracts image URLs from all slide sources at build time and intelligently schedules preloading at runtime based on navigation. The system should eliminate visible loading flashes when navigating between slides by preloading images before they're needed.
functional_requirements: Extract image URLs from all slide sources including frontmatter properties, markdown image syntax, Vue component props, and CSS url() references, storing them in a dedicated field on slide metadata
Generate preload link tags in the HTML head at build time for all extracted images to enable early browser loading

Create a runtime composable that implements navigation-aware scheduling: immediately preload images for current, previous, next, and configurable look-ahead slides, then load remaining slides after a delay
Add configuration support to enable/disable preloading and customize the look-ahead window size via frontmatter settings
